summary: The convention opens with both claimants watching from spectator seats while the credentials report waits.
realLife: The contemporary Freedom Democrats report says both Mississippi groups were offered spectator places on opening day while entitlement to the state seats remained unresolved.
gates: The convention has opened with a live credentials dispute.
inGame: needs: distinct spectator credentials, contested seats and the date of the ruling.

turns.what: Ushers take the newly seated delegates down to the floor.
turns.pulledBy: The report arrives during the first session.
turns.writesBack: Their voting status begins with that ruling.

turns.what: Both groups return with spectator credentials again.
turns.pulledBy: The meeting recesses without a report.
turns.writesBack: The next roll still lists the state as disputed.
